data.spec: Source packages/contracts/src/index.ts and apps/device/firmware/README.md. DeviceCommand={station_id:'kitchen'|'bathroom'|'printer',text:string,color:'blue'|'amber'|'green'|'red'}. GET /api/devices/:station/command supplies latest command (may be null). Bridge sends newline-delimited JSON {action:'office_feedback',value:DeviceCommand}, using immediate EventResponse feedback and ~1s latest-state polling, suppressing unchanged commands; null leaves display unchanged. office_feedback is a project-specific firmware handler to implement/verify, not confirmed stock behavior. Physical mapping must be confirmed; do not overwrite existing observed atech-serial-events contract.
